examples.name: NYC Running Clubs Website
examples.description: Create and deploy a website listing NYC running clubs

payload.prompt: Create a responsive website that lists all major running clubs in New York City with their meeting schedules, locations, and contact information. Deploy the website to S3 with static website hosting enabled and set up CloudFront distribution. Return the CloudFront URL as the final output.
payload.append_system_prompt: Ensure the website is mobile-responsive, uses modern CSS, and includes proper SEO meta tags. When deploying to AWS, use boto3 and ensure all resources are properly tagged.

examples.name: REST API Development
examples.description: Build a complete REST API with database

payload.prompt: Create a REST API for a library management system using Python FastAPI. Include endpoints for books, authors, and borrowers with full CRUD operations. Use SQLAlchemy for database ORM and include proper validation, error handling, and API documentation.

examples.name: Data Analysis Pipeline
examples.description: Create a data processing and visualization pipeline

payload.prompt: Build a Python data analysis pipeline that fetches weather data from a public API, processes it using pandas, creates visualizations with matplotlib, and generates an HTML report. Include error handling and logging.
payload.append_system_prompt: Use best practices for data processing, include data validation, and create informative visualizations with proper labels and legends.

examples.name: React Dashboard
examples.description: Create a modern React dashboard application

payload.prompt: Create a React dashboard application with charts, data tables, and a sidebar navigation. Use Material-UI for components and Recharts for data visualization. Include at least 3 different pages with sample data.

examples.name: Lambda Function with API Gateway
examples.description: Deploy a serverless function to AWS

payload.prompt: Create an AWS Lambda function that processes image uploads, resizes them, and stores them in S3. Set up API Gateway to trigger the function and return presigned URLs for uploads. Include proper IAM roles and error handling.
payload.append_system_prompt: Use boto3 for AWS operations, implement proper error handling, and ensure the Lambda function follows best practices for performance and security.

payload.prompt: Analyze the Python files in the current directory and generate comprehensive documentation including a README, API reference, and usage examples. Use docstrings and type hints to extract information.
Create a database schema for an e-commerce platform with tables for users, products, orders, and reviews. Generate SQL migration scripts and a Python script using SQLAlchemy to manage the schema.

examples.name: CI/CD Pipeline
examples.description: Set up a complete CI/CD pipeline

payload.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions workflow for a Node.js application that runs tests, builds the application, and deploys to AWS S3. Include stages for linting, testing, building, and deployment with proper secrets management.
